{{Top|ca|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
A [[Chevin pilgrim sect|small sect]] of members of the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]]<ref name="ARCH">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Pilgrimage}}</ref> [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Chevin}}</ref> made a pilgrimage to a '''nameless blue sun''' every three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] for a ritual.<ref name="ARCH" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates/1|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Pilgrimage" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> by which point the ritual had become ancient, the sect journeyed to the [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Star/Legends|sun]] again.<ref name="ARCH" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
By that year,<ref name="Date" /> an individual affiliated with one of the two opposing governments in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] had a companion follow the sect on their pilgrimage to the sun in order to learn their history. The sect welcomed the companion and took them to its [[Chevin pilgrim stronghold|stronghold]].<ref name="ARCH" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The blue star was mentioned in the Crew Skill Mission "Pilgrimage" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the [[Star Wars video games|video game]].<ref name="ARCH" />
